What This Fundraiser Is

We Want a Chiefs Christmas is a brand-new holiday album created by IDSAI in partnership with Rogue Round Table (RRT), a Kansas City–based nonprofit.

It’s our way of saying thank you to a city that always shows up to help others—and of raising the flexible, local funding needed to keep KC kids fed when systems fall short.

When families across KC faced challenges from government shutdowns, rising costs, and benefit cuts, we saw school lunch debt growing quietly in the background and food pantries struggling to keep up. This album is a joyful, creative way to respond:

  • Bring some light back into a stressed-out season.
  • Raise cash that can move quickly where it’s most needed.
  • Help kids and families without adding shame or red tape.

Release date: November 20, 2025 · Fundraiser runs through New Year’s Eve · Available exclusively through this campaign.

Why Kansas City Needs This Right Now

Kansas City is showing up everywhere—food drives, hygiene drives, school support, pantry volunteers—but the need has outpaced the resources. Families are slipping through the cracks in ways most people never see.

Local nonprofits and outreach groups have shared the same urgent concerns:

  • Fresh food is coming in spoiled or unusable.
  • Canned donations are often expired.
  • Homeless outreach teams can’t access soft foods like bananas, yogurt, or oatmeal.
  • Pantries have little to no meat, butter, dairy, or formula.
  • Schools can’t send home the snacks and kid-friendly items they’ve supplied for years.
  • Longtime distributors are stretched past capacity.

This fundraiser’s purpose is simple: Connect the gaps. Fund the work. Feed the families. Keep it local.

Where Your Donation Goes

All funds stay in the Kansas City metro area

We focus on cash support because partners like Harvesters and other local networks can stretch every dollar further through discounted wholesale pricing. That means your donation reaches more people, more efficiently, than if we bought retail goods ourselves.

Every donation is used for things like:

  • Fresh foods (produce, dairy, eggs, and meat when possible)
  • Soft foods for neighbors without teeth or with medical needs
  • Kid snacks & school support items
  • Formula and baby staples
  • Pantry restock for high-need partners
  • Micro-grants for KC nonprofits filling specific gaps
  • Emergency family assistance for groceries and basics

We’re not replacing anyone’s work. We’re reinforcing it. This campaign helps fill the gaps that other programs can’t reach fast enough.

How to Help & How to Partner

Simple, transparent, KC-centered

  1. Donate. Click any “Donate & Get the Album” button to give through Givebutter.
  2. Get the album. Every donor receives access instructions for the full We Want a Chiefs Christmas project.
  3. Turn it up & pass it on. Play it at home, at work, and at watch parties—and invite others to donate so every listen helps another KC family.

If you’re a business, nonprofit, community org, school, church, or workplace, we’d love to partner with you.

Choose your lane:

  • Funding Partner — direct financial support or match campaigns.
  • Resource Partner — goods, services, or pickup/delivery capabilities.
  • Amplifier — share the campaign with your customers, congregation, or staff.
  • Host Site — play the album and invite donations at your workplace or event.
  • Cross-Collaboration Partner — help coordinate pipelines between multiple orgs.

Partnership inquiries: vjm@innovation-dreams.com

For Other Cities

If your city has a strong base of Chiefs supporters—or you just love the model—and you’d like to use this album (or a similar idea) to support families where you live, reach out.

We can either:

  • Donate the entire album to your community as a fundraiser, or
  • Guide you on how to create a similar project tailored to your area.

Our ultimate goal is simple: stronger, better-connected communities that take care of each other.
